Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

OPENS Ch 7: SONS' REFUSAL-SPEECH addressed-to-Ṣiruṣaydan paralleling the 1 Mq 2:5-19 brothers' creation-confession-and-anti-idolatry-creed. The five-sons-of-Maqabis-of-Moab (named at 13:1) deliver an interlocking speech-cycle: each son speaks in turn refusing idol-sacrifice on creational + covenantal + moral + eschatological + Christological-or-messianic grounds (the five-fold-argumentation schema). The pattern parallels: 2 MACCABEES 7:1-42 (the seven brothers and their interlocking speeches — the Greek-Maccabean canonical-model for serial-martyr-speech-cycles); 4 MACCABEES 9-12 (the same seven brothers' speeches elaborated philosophically); DANIEL 3:16-18 (Shadrach + Meshach + Abednego's 'we will not serve thy gods' speech). Meqabyan's distinctive feature: the FIVE-FOLD (not seven-fold) brothers-speech-cycle replicates the 1 Mq five-brothers structural number-symmetry (vs LXX 2 Macc seven-brothers). The Meqabyan compositional-signature of five-fold-martyr-structures across both 1 Mq and 2 Mq is one of Horovitz 1905's clearest internal-coherence evidences.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

IDOL-REJECTION FORMULA following 1 Mq 2:18-19 PARALLEL (vv. 9-14): the sons' explicit anti-idolatry-creed echoing the 1 Mq brothers' creedal-corrective — 'they do not believe in your law but trust in GOLD AND SILVER, AND IN STONE AND WOOD MADE BY THE HAND OF MAN.' The four-fold idol-material-list (gold + silver + stone + wood) is identical to 1 Mq 2:18 and grounds the two martyrdom-cycles in the SAME ANTI-IDOLATRY THEOLOGICAL FRAMEWORK. The cross-book consistency in idol-vocabulary supports Horovitz 1905's structural argument for shared-redactional-layer across 1 Mq + 2 Mq. Direct biblical parallels: PSALM 115:4-7 LXX ('their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands'); PSALM 135:15-18; ISAIAH 44:9-20 (the long anti-idolatry-satire of carved-wood-worship); WISDOM 13-15; HABAKKUK 2:18-19; JEREMIAH 10:1-16. The interlocking-creedal-framework across the trilogy's three books at this verse + 1 Mq 2:18 + 3 Mq 1:1 makes the anti-idolatry creed the GLUE binding the three-book composite.
